title: 第3章 十大境界第4章 苏家
content_zh:
清晨，天空泛起一抹鱼肚白，车夫又架着马车继续向前赶去。
车厢内，苏辰打了个激灵，猛地坐起身，瞪大了眼睛，大口大口喘息起来，没有血色的脸庞上还带着几分惊魂未定之色。
“昨天晚上，是梦么……”
苏辰将信将疑。
是梦的话，未免太真实了一些，可如果不是梦……
洛雪儿被苏辰的突然举动吓了一跳，连忙走上前，一手抚摸着苏辰的后背，一手拿着手帕，去擦拭苏辰额头上的冷汗：
“少爷，你昨晚上是不是做噩梦了？我听你一直念叨什么太上武神诀什么的。”
“嗯……好像是。”
苏辰晃了晃脑袋，感觉自己隐隐有些头痛。
洛雪儿的眼眶发红，心疼的将苏辰搂入自己的怀中：“少爷，这些天你一定不要多想，只要能活下来，就有重新修炼的希望……你就当是为了雪儿，安心恢复身体，好吗？”
洛雪儿自然而然的认为，苏辰晚上呢喃修炼法门，是心中不甘的缘故。
“你放心吧，我不会有轻生的想法。”
苏辰点头。
“那少爷你好好休息，再路过下一个镇子，我给你买粥喝。”
洛雪儿眉毛这才舒展开，柔声道。
“嗯。”
苏辰应了一声，闭上眼睛。
“这些到底是梦境，还是现实？”
苏辰内心有些恍惚。
那梦星的所说之话，还有传授下的那功法，都是骇人听闻。

苏辰不得不怀疑这是不是自己太渴求力量而产生的梦境。
但这《太上武神诀》好像是确确实实存在的，他沉下心神，便感受到脑海中多出的那段浩瀚讯息，强压住激动的内心，仔细感受起来。
这功法玄妙万分，但每一个穴位，每一道经脉，都无比的清晰，每一个境界都有相应的修炼之法。
“这不是梦！
我当真拥有了重新走上修炼道路的方法！”
苏辰激动万分，一张脸涨的通红，双拳也不禁猛地攥了起来，身体微微颤抖。
在“梦境”
之中，他之所以平静，是因为觉得一切太过梦幻。
可到了现实中，苏辰却难以平静！
沦为废物的自己，竟然又有了重新修炼的希望！
当即，苏辰按捺不住激动的心情，开始运转《太上武神诀》的第一层的修炼法门。
随着他心中默念，也渐渐进入到一种空灵的状态，感受到了天地之间的元气，然后在功法的牵引之下，将这些元气汇入自己的体内。
滋滋！
大量的天地元气如同怒海狂涛一般，从四面八方吸纳过来，涌入到苏辰的身体之中，让苏辰忍不住心中震颤。
他修炼多年，吸纳天地元气本就是驾轻就熟的事情，不会因为吸纳元气本身而震惊。
让他不敢置信的是，他当初修炼的也是一门十分强大的功法，可吸纳天地元气的速度只有现在的十分之一！
《太上武神诀》到底是何等品级的功法？
只不过此时的苏辰已经没有太多时间去震惊，而是尽可能的将这些天地元气储存在身体之中。
一般武者修炼，天地元气是从经脉之中汇入丹田，在丹田之中储存，化为元力。
content_en:
In the early morning, a touch of fish belly white appeared in the sky, and the driver continued to move forward with the carriage.
In the carriage, Su Chen shuddered and sat up suddenly. His eyes widened and he gasped for air. There was a hint of shock on his bloodless face.
"Last night, was it a dream..."
Su Chen was doubtful.
If it is a dream, it would be too real, but if it is not a dream...
Luo Xueer was startled by Su Chen's sudden move, and quickly stepped forward, stroking Su Chen's back with one hand, and holding a handkerchief in the other to wipe the cold sweat on Su Chen's forehead:
"Master, did you have a nightmare last night? I heard you keep talking about the Taishang Martial God Technique or something like that."
"Hmm...it seems so."
Su Chen shook his head and felt a slight headache.
Luo Xue'er's eyes were red, and she hugged Su Chen into her arms distressedly: "Master, you must not think too much these days. As long as you can survive, there is hope of practicing again... Just treat it as if it is for Xue'er, and recover with peace of mind, okay?"
Luo Xueer naturally believed that Su Chen's murmuring about cultivation methods at night was due to his unwillingness.
"Don't worry, I won't have any thoughts of committing suicide."
Su Chen nodded.
"Then young master, please have a good rest. When we pass by the next town, I will buy you some porridge."
Luo Xueer's eyebrows relaxed and she said softly.
"Yeah."
Su Chen responded and closed his eyes.
"Are these dreams or reality?"
Su Chen felt a little dazed inside.
What Mengxing said and the techniques he taught were all shocking.
Su Chen had to wonder if this was a dream caused by his excessive thirst for power.
But the "Tai Shang Martial God Art" seemed to really exist. He calmed down and felt the vast information in his mind. He suppressed his excitement and felt it carefully.
This technique is extremely mysterious, but every acupuncture point and every meridian is extremely clear, and every realm has its own corresponding cultivation method.
"This is not a dream!
I really have a way to get back on the path of cultivation! "
Su Chen was so excited that his face turned red, his fists clenched violently, and his body trembled slightly.
In "Dreamland"
Among them, the reason why he was calm was because he felt that everything was too dreamy.
But in reality, Su Chen couldn't calm down!
After being reduced to a waste, he actually has hope of cultivating again!
Immediately, Su Chen couldn't restrain his excitement and began to operate the first level of the "Tai Shang Martial God Technique".
As he recited silently in his heart, he gradually entered an ethereal state, feeling the vitality between heaven and earth, and then, under the guidance of the technique, he merged these vitality into his body.
Zizzi!
A large amount of heaven and earth vitality was absorbed from all directions like the roaring waves of the angry sea, and poured into Su Chen's body, making Su Chen couldn't help but tremble in his heart.
He has been practicing for many years, and absorbing the energy of heaven and earth is something he is familiar with, and he will not be shocked by absorbing the energy itself.
What made him unbelievable was that he was practicing a very powerful technique back then, but the speed at which he could absorb the energy of heaven and earth was only one-tenth of what it is now!
What kind of skill is "Tai Shang Martial God Technique"?
It's just that at this time, Su Chen didn't have much time to be shocked, but instead stored the energy of heaven and earth in his body as much as possible.
When ordinary warriors practice, the vitality of heaven and earth flows into the Dantian from the meridians, is stored in the Dantian, and turns into Yuanli.
